facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Peter felt sick. Mother brought a blanket. She was very kind. Mother put him to bed.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Peter was not feeling well after his big adventure. Mother Rabbit checked his temperature and looked worried. She brought a soft blanket and a fluffy pillow. Mother put him to bed and tucked him in gently. Peter whispered thank you as his eyes closed. He felt safe and warm in his cozy bed.
